name: cecc-monorepo
description: Claude Engineering Control Center — local-first engineering observability, workflow, security and quality control for AI-assisted development.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cecc/core && npm run build -w @cecc/ml && npm run build -w @cecc/cli
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build:dashboard && npm run icons && npm run stage:desktop
scripts.desktop:start: npm run desktop && npm run start -w cecc-desktop
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run desktop && npm run dist:linux -w cecc-desktop
scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop && npm run dist:win -w cecc-desktop
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run desktop && npm run dist:mac -w cecc-desktop
